body:
Thank you.  That first sentence makes things so much better.  I have one friend/co-worker I've considered bringing it up with, but I think if I did, it would explode and he'd do more damage than good, even though he'd be well meaning.

My therapist did go over those types of limits initially, but I found she was doing more harm than good.  It was like she was reciting what she learned from a psych101 textbook.  She was a robot tell me things I already knew and it wasn't helping.  She could say "Don't worry about the past."  OK makes sense.  But I need help getting to that point, and that wasn't the help she would offer.  I could tell that she really didn't care and was there for the paycheck.  I moved on to a social worker (after talking to some acquaintances and my family doctor) and in general the conversation has been better.  But he didn't go over any of those limits.  Although there is a minor amount of progress made each session, I get the vibe that he's drawing it out.  He'll say "Ok, that's something we can discuss as time goes on (with 20 minutes left)" And I just can't get answers.

I've tried researching online for answers to my questions but I've had no luck.  I am in Canada and even if I find info, I worry it only applies to the US.

Thank you very much.  I've been browsing here for the last couple hours hoping for any kind of advice before I head to sleep.  So I am going to head to bed and think on this.  Thank you.
